name: FX_Fireball_Back

textures.channels: RGB straight colour (sRGB) + alpha = opacity; 6 x 6 frames of 256 px, row by row from the top left

source_note: a Mantaflow gas simulation (a ball of burning fuel in a head wind, resolution 112) rendered by Cycles as an emitting volume with an orthographic camera raised 14 degrees, from behind the ball (it flies away); one frame per step, the loop closed by a 12-frame cross-fade; sparks are analytic 3D paths projected through the same camera
supersedes: the upright side-view fireball card on the south and north flights
dresses: the fireball spell along its flight: a ball of fire 0.35 m across, flames wrapped round it and a short trail of flame and sparks behind
